steps.en: Install the CLI and start a local dev server
steps.zh: 安装 CLI，启动本地开发服务端
steps.code: brew install temporal · temporal server start-dev

steps.en: Runs the server services with a Web UI for inspecting workflows
steps.zh: 跑起服务端各服务，并提供查看工作流的 Web UI

steps.en: Write the flow as a deterministic workflow plus side-effecting activities in an SDK
steps.zh: 用 SDK 把流程写成确定性的 workflow 加有副作用的 activity

steps.en: Run a worker on a task queue and start the workflow from a client
steps.zh: 在一个任务队列上跑 worker，再从客户端启动工作流

steps.en: Appends every step to the workflow's event history and retries failed activities
steps.zh: 把每一步追加进工作流的事件历史，失败的 activity 自动重试

steps.en: If a worker dies, another replays the history and resumes at the same step
steps.zh: worker 挂了，另一个 worker 重放历史，从同一步继续

value.en: Multi-step processes survive crashes and deploys without hand-written state tables, retry loops or polling crons
value.zh: 多步流程扛得住崩溃和发布，不用再手写状态表、重试循环和轮询 cron
